chapters.title: Ill-Conditioning
chapters.blurb: Why one learning rate can't serve two curvatures: the condition number of the loss is the exact slowdown factor, and momentum and Adam are two ways of shrinking it.

chapters.title: Learning-Rate Schedules
chapters.blurb: Real stochastic descent under constant-high, constant-low, and cosine schedules — big steps travel, small steps land, and a warmup ramp keeps a cold start from exploding.

chapters.title: Batch Size and Noise
chapters.blurb: Sixty-four noisy points, one bowl-shaped loss: the fan of per-example gradients collapses at the root-B rate, then cheap noisy steps beat smooth ones per example seen.

chapters.title: Bias and Variance
chapters.blurb: Resample the training set thirty times and error splits in two: fits wrong the same way every time, and fits wrong a different way each time — decomposition verified to the third decimal.
